Maybe we should move the `rendering_device*` files to a folder, so we don't need to hardcode all the files we want to compile always or conditionally.

Our convention to do stuff like:
```
servers/some_server/some_server_foo.cpp
servers/some_server/some_server_foo.h
servers/some_server/some_server_bar.cpp
servers/some_server/some_server_bar.h
servers/some_server.cpp
servers/some_server.h
```
is pretty confusing. If we're making some of the servers or server components opt out, maybe we should review that convention and actually put related stuff in the same folder.

A full refactor of this stuff is for a separate proposal / PR of course, as the impact on the codebase would be significant.

But we could maybe get away with moving `rendering_device.*` to `servers/rendering/renderer_rd`.

Let's wait for @clayjohn and @BastiaanOlij to chime in though.
